Fix - Add string decoding: read offset, then length, then UTF-8 data - Add bytes decoding: read offset, length, raw data - Add dynamic array decoding: read offset, length, then elements - Document your changes by adding the standard @fix-aut

title: [ClankerNation/OpenAgents] [ Bounty $9k ] [ API ] Fix agents.py doesn't validate endpoint URL format — testnet finding
description: The register agent endpoint in api/routes/agents.py accepts any string as the agent endpoint. Invalid URLs cause crashes when the system tries to contact the agent. Fix - Validate URL format: must be valid http/https URL - Check URL is reachable with a HEAD request (timeout 5s) - Reject private/internal IPs (SSRF protection) - Per the project's contributor tracking convention, prepend a documentation block
